name: ifms

scripts.build: npm run db:prepare && prisma generate && next build
scripts.deploy:start: node scripts/pre-deploy-schema.mjs && prisma db push --skip-generate && node scripts/post-deploy-data.mjs && (npm run db:seed || echo '[deploy] seed skipped — see logs above') && next start
scripts.db:push: npm run db:prepare && prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:prepare && prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:prepare && prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm run db:prepare && prisma generate && prisma db push && npm run db:seed

//dependencies: Anything `next build`, `prisma generate` or the deploy start command needs at build time lives here, NOT in devDependencies. Platforms that set NODE_ENV=production during the build (Railway, Heroku, Nixpacks) make npm skip devDependencies entirely, so a build-time package placed there is simply absent when the build runs.
